item.title: Hitch Open Open-Sources Physical Intelligence Platform, Sets 142-Rally Robot Ping-Pong Record
item.description:
Hitch Open, a Berkeley-rooted open-source physical intelligence platform, made its global debut at the China International Import Expo and was released open source worldwide. At the event, a team from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai Innovation Institute, working with the platform, set a new world record of 142 rallies in autonomous AI robot ping-pong. The platform uses extreme real-world competitions to drive perception-decision-action loops for autonomous driving and embodied intelligence.

原文标题：Hitch Open 开源物理智能平台 机器人乒乓对打创 142 拍纪录

Why it matters：开源具身智能平台叠加可验证的世界纪录挑战，对关注机器人与物理智能的读者有参考价值。

item.title: SWANCOR's Qiyuan Robot Hits 10,000 Units as Monthly Active Rate Tops 98%
item.description:
SWANCOR's Qiyuan Robotics rolled out its 10,000th personal robot, with co-president Liu Dongfang disclosing operating metrics including over 98% monthly active rate, 3 hours of daily online time and 100+ daily interactions per user. Qiyuan Q1 and T1 also received their first post-launch OTA, adding new character roles and terrain-aware following.

Why it matters：个人机器人量产里程碑与高粘性运营数据值得关注，但缺乏技术参数与可验证方法，信息增量有限。

item.title: China Energy Bureau: Computing Demand Drives Rigid Power Growth of 600 Billion kWh Annually
item.description:
China's National Energy Administration said at a 15th Five-Year Plan briefing that emerging industries such as computing will drive rigid growth in electricity demand, with annual increments of about 600 billion kWh, equivalent to adding three Shanghai's worth of consumption each year. It also set a 2030 supply adequacy target above 1.1, keeping a 10% reserve margin at peak load through coordinated generation, grid, load and storage measures.

原文标题：国家能源局：算力等新兴产业带动用电刚性增长，年均新增 6000 亿度

Why it matters：官方首次将算力明确列为用电刚性增长的主要驱动力，为 AI 基础设施的能源约束提供了权威量化参照。

item.title: Bernstein Estimates OpenAI Compute Spending at $614 Billion by 2030
item.description:
Bernstein analysts estimate that infrastructure spending tied to OpenAI's disclosed compute contracts could total about $614 billion by 2030, well below the $750 billion figure previously reported, with annual outlays peaking at $184 billion in 2031. The firm also warns that specialist compute providers reliant on costly financing and sustained leasing demand face greater pressure once supply tightens ease.

原文标题：伯恩斯坦测算 OpenAI 2030 年算力支出约 6140 亿美元

Why it matters：这是对 OpenAI 算力承诺规模的一次量化修正，直接影响对云厂商与算力供应链的长期预期。

item.title: GAC Humanoid Robot Unit Targets 10,000-Unit Capacity by 2029
item.description:
Huilun Technology, spun off from GAC Group, signed a production cooperation agreement with GAC Powertrain BU to build humanoid robot capacity of 10,000 units per year by 2029. GAC's humanoid robots remain in small-batch deployment, with cumulative operation of over 12 months, 63,000 km and 189,000 cycles. Huilun closed a funding round of over RMB 100 million in August to optimize vertical models and expand production-line scenarios.

原文标题：广汽人形机器人计划 2029 年形成万台产能

Why it matters：这是车企布局人形机器人的产能规划信号，但缺乏具体技术参数与产品细节，属于产业动向而非技术节点。

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol Performs Live Mouse Brain Surgery, Halving Positioning Error in Three Runs
item.description:
OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol carried out three consecutive anatomical-landmark localization tasks in live mouse stereotaxic surgery at Exin Therapeutics, using surgeon feedback for in-context learning without retraining: positioning error fell from 0.6 mm to 0.3 mm and manual corrections from four to two. It signals AI moving from analyzing research data to directly operating real lab equipment, though the three-run sample is tiny and not peer-reviewed, leaving human surgery far off.

原文标题：GPT-6.1 Sol 参与活体小鼠脑手术 三次操作定位误差减半

Why it matters：前沿模型首次以闭环反馈方式直接操控活体手术设备并量化改进，是智能体落地实体操作的关键早期样本。

item.title: Swancor's Qiyuan Robotics Hits 10,000 Units One Month Into Mass Production
item.description:
Swancor's Qiyuan Robotics announced its 10,000th personal robot rolled off the line, just 14 days after reaching 5,000 units, indicating a fast production ramp. The Q1 is an 88cm foldable humanoid starting at RMB 19,999, while the T1 can switch between wheeled-humanoid and quadruped forms at the same entry price. The news signals progress in consumer-grade humanoid mass production and falling prices, though no detailed technical specs or performance metrics were disclosed.

原文标题：上纬新材启元机器人量产一个月 第 10000 台下线

Why it matters：消费级人形机器人量产爬坡与低价定价是产业信号，但缺乏技术参数，注意力价值有限。

item.title: Menlo Ventures: Chinese Open-Source Models Capture 89% of Enterprise Spend, Kimi Leads
item.description:
A Menlo Ventures report finds that Chinese open-source AI models account for 89% of global enterprise open-source model spending, with Moonshot's Kimi leading at 61%, followed by DeepSeek at 15% and Zhipu's GLM at 11%. Meta's Llama, the top Western model, holds only 7%, signaling a clear shift of enterprise open-source adoption toward Chinese vendors.

原文标题：Menlo Ventures：中国开源模型占企业支出 89%，Kimi 居首

Why it matters：该报告以具体支出份额数据揭示企业开源模型采购格局的显著东移，对判断开源生态竞争态势具有参考价值。

item.title: Blogger Claims AI Lab Fired Engineer Over Agent-Based Code Review
item.description:
Blogger Yuchen Jin relayed a post claiming an AI lab partly fired an engineer for using AI agents to review and auto-merge non-production code, saying the team would rather let PRs take weeks to merge. The claim rests on a single secondhand account with no lab name, response, or primary evidence, so it remains unverified.

Why it matters：涉及 AI 辅助编码与工程流程冲突的争议传闻，但证据薄弱，仅作行业风向参考。

item.title: Nous Research Open-Sources Arete-27B Fine-Tune to Strip Chinese State Framing
item.description:
Nous Research has open-sourced Arete-27B, a Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune trained with plain supervised fine-tuning on 52.8M tokens using Inkling as teacher, with no RL or architecture changes. On its self-built 803-prompt eval, propaganda-style answers dropped from 22% to 0.9%, while factuality mean rose only from 2.32 to 2.98 out of 5 and still trails Muse Glimmer 30B; 216 of 803 answers still score 0, and both eval and training data are self-constructed and self-judged.

原文标题：Nous Research 开源 Arete-27B 微调模型 去除中文官方叙事倾向

Why it matters：以极低成本验证“对齐层较浅”的假设，并完整公开权重、数据与评测，对关注开源微调与模型行为干预的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Study of 200K Research Sessions Finds Data Analysis Dominates AI Use
item.description:
Anthropic analyzed roughly 207,000 research-related Claude sessions and found data analysis accounts for about a third of usage and writing another 30%, while hypothesis generation—ranked most important by scientists—makes up only 4.2%. The report pairs an AI capability score with a usage-multiplier metric, estimating that full automation of non-manual work could speed computer science and statistics research by about 15x, versus 3-4x in chemistry and biology where lab work remains a bottleneck.

原文标题：Anthropic 分析 20 万次科研会话：数据分析用得最多，提想法反而最少

Why it matters：这是少见的基于大规模真实会话的 AI 科研使用画像，量化了“AI 擅长什么、科学家看重什么”之间的错位。

item.title: ChatGPT Account Bans Hit Even $200 Pro Subscribers
item.description:
Multiple users on Reddit and OpenAI's developer forum report their ChatGPT accounts were deactivated without warning, including $200-per-month Pro subscribers; some appeals were rejected and stored chats and notes became inaccessible. OpenAI support only directs users to email or appeal forms without explaining causes or disclosing how many accounts were affected, leaving open whether this is a coordinated or erroneous ban wave.

原文标题：ChatGPT 突发封号风波 200 美元 Pro 用户亦被停用

Why it matters：付费用户无预警封号直接触及账号资产与数据可访问性风险，对依赖 ChatGPT 的开发者与重度用户具有现实警示意义。

item.title: MAPLE Pruning Runs Gemma 4 26B at 45 TPS on a 6GB GPU
item.description:
An independent researcher released MAPLE, a structural pruning method for mixture-of-experts LLMs that removes dormant experts, shrinking Gemma 4 26B-A4B from 9.92 GB to 4.75 GB (about 1.48 bits per parameter) so it runs entirely in 6 GB of laptop VRAM at 45.4 tokens per second. The checkpoint is specialized for Python coding and STEM reasoning, and the pipeline is claimed to be domain-agnostic.

原文标题：MAPLE 剪枝让 Gemma 4 26B 在 6GB 显卡跑出 45 TPS

Why it matters：在消费级 6 GB 显存上跑通 26B 级 MoE 模型，对本地部署与端侧推理读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Details Agent Memory Design, Adding a Dreaming Step to Correct Notes
item.description:
Anthropic's engineering team detailed a four-layer memory architecture for Claude spanning raw session logs, self-written notes, structured wikis, and auto-injected context, plus a post-session 'dreaming' step that revisits transcripts to fix and reorganize notes. Pokemon and database-QA tests show memory quality, not volume, drives performance, with Opus 5 the first model to form a complete learning loop.

原文标题：Anthropic 拆解智能体记忆：Claude 边干边记，靠“做梦”纠错整理

item.title: Yao Shunyu Says AI Moats Lie in Product Layer, Private Data and Trust
item.description:
Tencent chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu, responding to Tsinghua professor Zhang Ya-Qin, argued that AI moats sit at the product layer rather than the model layer: proprietary data and context that rivals cannot access, plus user trust in letting AI act on that data. Zhang joked that this implies Anthropic's valuation rests on shaky ground as models commoditize.

原文标题：姚顺雨：AI 护城河在产品层，私有数据与信任是关键

Why it matters：来自头部厂商 AI 负责人的护城河判断，对理解模型同质化趋势下的产品竞争有参考价值。

item.title: Baoyu: Agents Must Submit Screenshot Evidence for Human Acceptance
item.description:
To address the opacity of AI agent task results, Baoyu proposes requiring agents to self-test and generate screenshots as evidence of completion for human reviewers. The practice borrows from his team's rule that engineers attach feature screenshots to pull requests, and it lets agents catch and fix issues during the screenshot process.

原文标题：宝玉：Agent 完成任务须提交截图证据供人类验收

Why it matters：来自一线开发者的 Agent 验收实践，方法简单可复制，对使用 Agent 的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: TSMC Denies Developing 3D DRAM at Nvidia's Request
item.description:
TSMC denied a The Information report that it is developing 3D DRAM at Nvidia's request, reiterating its focus on logic chip foundry. 3D DRAM stacks memory cells vertically to boost density, but major memory makers remain years from mass production; TSMC is more likely to capture memory growth via HBM logic base dies and SoIC hybrid bonding.

原文标题：台积电否认应英伟达要求研发 3D DRAM

Why it matters：AI 内存供应紧张背景下，代工龙头与最大客户的 3D DRAM 传闻及官方否认，牵动 AI 供应链格局判断。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Expectations Slip to $1.2 Trillion, Halving in a Month
item.description:
Anthropic begins its IPO roadshow next week with buyer-side valuations now discussed at $1.2–1.3 trillion, down from as high as $2 trillion in early October, with some considering only $1.1 trillion. This week's tech selloff and pressure on data-center stocks have hit the pricing thesis that AI capex keeps delivering hypergrowth. Priced in this range, Anthropic would be the first frontier model lab to go public, and whether it keeps its valuation edge over OpenAI may shape how far it concedes on price.

原文标题：Anthropic 上市估值预期降至 1.2 万亿美元，较一个月前腰斩

Why it matters：首家前沿大模型公司 IPO 定价区间一个月内腰斩，是观察 AI 资本周期与市场情绪转向的关键信号。

item.title: UChicago Mathematician Says AI Era Hiring Will Prize Research Vision and Communication
item.description:
University of Chicago mathematician Frank Calegari argues that as AI makes it easier to mass-produce proofs, hiring committees can no longer rely on a single paper or result. He says recruitment should lean more on face-to-face conversation that probes a candidate's research vision and ability to explain it, and that departments must train graduate students in mathematical communication.

原文标题：芝加哥大学教授称 AI 时代数学招聘更看重研究愿景与表达

Why it matters：这是一线数学家的观点性讨论，折射 AI 对学术评价与人才选拔机制的冲击，但缺乏具体数据与可验证方法。

item.title: Salesforce 研究：从外部大模型蒸馏不如强化学习划算
item.description:
Salesforce 新论文以“每单位训练算力对应的留出准确率”为口径，对比在线策略蒸馏与 GRPO。结论是：从外部已后训练的大模型蒸馏通常比直接做 RL 更耗算力，且容易拉长回答长度；而先用 RL 训练各领域专家、再蒸馏合并为单一学生模型，可在数学与代码任务上以少 42% 的总 FLOPs 追平联合 GRPO。

Why it matters：该研究给出了反直觉的算力账本，并提供了可复用的“先 RL 专家、后蒸馏合并”低成本配方。

item.title: 埃森哲报告被指含 15 条虚假引用，否认系 AI 幻觉所致
item.description:
GPTZero 分析指出，埃森哲与马德里 IE 大学合作发布的《跨越式发展》报告含 15 条虚假引用及完全虚构的案例研究，正接受外界审查。埃森哲否认错误源于 AI 幻觉，称内部审查认定为人为失误，并正在修正报告。此事凸显咨询与法律行业广泛使用 AI 后，幻觉内容污染信息源的风险正在上升。

Why it matters：头部咨询公司报告被指含虚假引用，折射 AI 幻觉污染专业内容与信息源的行业性风险。

item.description:

Why it matters：这是来自政策与投资视角的算力供给预警，直接关系未来两年 AI 训练与推理算力的可得性与成本。

item.title: 中国电信完成千公里空芯光纤双向实时传输验证
item.description:
中国电信研究院、长飞公司与中兴通讯联合完成全球首个千公里空芯光纤双向实时传输验证，在 1007.48 公里线路上实现双向各 64Tb/s 同步传输，单程时延仅 3.43 毫秒。该试验证明空芯光纤可复用现有传输设备，时延较实芯光纤降低约 30%，为算力网长距离低时延互联储备关键技术。

Why it matters：空芯光纤千公里级实时传输首次跑通，直接关系算力网跨域互联的时延与容量上限。

item.title: 美国国会拟立法禁止 AI 递归自我改进
item.description:
围绕“递归自我改进（RSI）”的禁令讨论正在升温。纽约州众议员 Alex Bores 援引 METR 报告称，OpenAI 计划在 2028 年 3 月前、Anthropic 员工称在 2027 年前实现 AI 自主构建下一代 AI，并主张国会在今年内立法禁止。该主张获得 Bernie Sanders、Yoshua Bengio、Arvind Narayanan 等跨阵营人士支持，但具体禁令机制与是否永久仍存争议。

item.title: 欧洲多国爆发抗议 要求暂停 AI 数据中心建设
item.description:
欧洲多国同步爆发反对数据中心扩张的抗议，都柏林约 2000 人、赫尔辛基约 1300 人上街，要求暂停建设直至公众通过民主程序决定 AI 基础设施的走向。争议焦点集中在土地与电力消耗、能源成本上涨及本地经济收益不足，爱尔兰 2025 年数据中心已占全国电表用电量的 23%，芬兰在建项目投资总额约 800 亿欧元。这一抵制浪潮与美国中期选举中数据中心成为地方议题的趋势相互呼应，正在成为 AI 算力扩张的现实约束。

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力扩张遭遇社会与政治阻力的标志性事件，直接影响数据中心选址、能源供给与监管走向。

item.title: 台积电否认进军 3D DRAM 坚持纯逻辑代工定位
item.description:
台积电公开否认了有关英伟达推动其转向 3D DRAM 的报道，重申将坚持纯逻辑代工路线。在 AI 需求挤占 DRAM 产能、内存成为加速器出货瓶颈的背景下，台积电选择通过 HBM 基础裸片与 SoIC 混合键合获取内存相关收益，而非自建 DRAM 产线。

Why it matters：这是关于 AI 算力供应链瓶颈与代工巨头战略边界的关键澄清，直接影响对内存产能与加速器交付节奏的判断。
